description: This file defines internal mechanisms for managing and registering built-in functions and operations in the PyTorch JIT compiler, including a table of built-in functions, their registration, and lookup utilities.

methods.name: _gen_torch_functional_registered_ops
methods.description: Generates a set of registered torch functional operations for internal use.

methods.name: _is_special_functional_bound_op
methods.description: Checks if a function is a special bound operation in torch functional.

methods.name: _get_builtin_table
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the table mapping built-in functions to their aten:: operation names.

methods.name: _register_builtin
methods.description: Registers a function as a built-in with a specified operation name.

methods.name: _find_builtin
methods.description: Retrieves the aten:: operation name for a given function if registered.
